Reading/design, simulations, compilation, actual runtime integration and target-hardware benchmarks are separate. Missing environments leave their hands-on gates incomplete; no paid provisioning or host-policy bypass is required or authorized.

All work uses original synthetic, owned and authorized fixtures. Quant work is paper-only; security work is defensive and isolated. Hypothetical PM participants, prices and outcomes are never presented as observed facts.
Readings are official/maintainer links, not rehosted protected content. Source availability checks are not runtime verification; access-limited sources are labelled.

stageOutcomes.outcome: Explain the language, representation and system boundary using hand-checkable original fixtures.
stageOutcomes.evidence: Retain an independent expected-result table, explicit invalid-input behavior and the actual prerequisites for execution.

stageOutcomes.outcome: Implement and compare the named tools or protocols while preserving data, identity and lifecycle invariants.
stageOutcomes.evidence: Retain actual supported-runtime integration, a bounded change and positive/negative regressions; unsupported environments remain visible.

stageOutcomes.outcome: Diagnose failure, concurrency, resource and compatibility behavior at the actual mechanism boundary.
stageOutcomes.evidence: Reproduce an original fault, repair its cause and compare against an independent oracle without substituting a simpler stack.

stageOutcomes.outcome: Defend operational, architectural and measurement decisions with evidence whose scope is explicit.
stageOutcomes.evidence: Produce an owned release/incident/benchmark or decision dossier, including negative results, alternatives, actual versus modelled scale and pending hardware.
